verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a pairing step or an explicit accept/approve prompt for a new device before it can view or control the screen. The only related items are unattended access with a permanent password, Server Pro's per-user and device-group access control, and 2FA. These are adjacent authentication and authorization controls, not device pairing or approval, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, a new device must be paired or explicitly approved before it can see or control the screen
